name: Wilson Auto Parts
old_description: For over four decades, Wilson Auto Parts has stood as a pillar of reliability in the wholesale automotive parts industry of northern New Jersey. Our dedication is to streamline your work, not add to it.
about:
Wilson Auto Parts has served the wholesale automotive parts market in northern New Jersey for over four decades. Headquartered in Plainfield, the company operates a network of eleven locations across the region, including Dover, Neptune City, Newark, Kearny, West Orange, Paterson, Roselle Park, Jersey City, Clifton, and Hackensack.

The distributor supplies a broad range of automotive parts and supplies to service stations, independent repair shops, and commercial garages. Its multi-branch model allows customers to source all needed components through a single call, with inventory drawn from across the network and billing consolidated into one invoice. The company leverages long-standing relationships with leading manufacturers to offer a comprehensive and cost-effective product range.

Primary customers include automotive service stations, repair shops, and fleet maintenance garages throughout northern New Jersey. The company's account managers and customer service specialists work to ensure parts are available when needed, at the best possible price.

Wilson Auto Parts was founded to streamline procurement for automotive service businesses, eliminating the hassle of multiple vendors and deliveries. The company states its mission is to deliver the right parts at the right time and price, backed by a team of industry-experienced account managers and customer service experts.
